scope: Incremental static closure of R1-R4 and failed-attempt preservation. Source parses; main not imported/executed; previous artificial mapping, delta and null checks reused, not repeated. This permits root to freeze the reviewed code and execute after its explicit original-scoring-PASS gate; it is not a run PASS.

closures.evidence: Before any contract identity hash, exact map key set must equal absolute self and PARENT. Both required SHA checks precede attempt. Sensor/output paths cannot enter this first list.

Each of four producer receipt/seal/NPZ identities must equal original score_receipt.input_sha256_before_after. score receipt and metrics SHA are bound; parent matches score receipt. All twelve producer identities are checked before GT loop. Each GT later matches parent row SHA and original scored-input SHA before decode. Seal semantic/schema validation is inherited from the original successful scorer for these exact bound bytes, not independently repeated.

Set plus len28 asserts every mode/index exactly once. Three partitions require exact3/3/4 method sets. Every fixed frame enters its group, and all four AbsRel/RMSE/delta1/prediction-invalid-fraction means retain null-if-any-null. Per-frame validGT, invalid-on-GT and delta hits remain integer-exact checks.
closures.remaining_scope_limit: Auxiliary aggregate metadata (defined-frame counters, invalid-all-grid sums, empty/invalid frame lists) are not all separately recomputed. Describe scope as 28 metric rows and all four means in all ten groups, not every JSON field.

closures.evidence: common_scope now persists producer_kind,validation_status,historical_observations_not_recorded,recovery_receipt_sha256,new_GA_runs,historical_GA_steps plus original_S26_status=FAILED_PRESERVED in final receipt. Recovery itself is inherited through exact original scored producer identity; no new recovery recomputation.

attempt.json created before producer/GT reads and existence rejects repeat. __main__ catches BaseException and writes FAIL receipt when an attempt exists and no receipt does; existing receipt is preserved. Preflight failures before attempt remain preflight and do not claim an experiment run.

required_execution_conditions: Run normal Python with assertions enabled, not python -O; this script uses asserts for gates
Root freezes exact reviewed self SHA plus actual parent SHA in the two-entry contract
Original S26B scoring must have passed with exact bound receipts and payloads
